data.title: Mandarin Oriental Residences
data.about:
Mandarin Oriental Residences by Aldar Properties at Saadiyat Island set a new benchmark for luxury real estate in Abu Dhabi. Choose from 1 to 5-bedroom homes, including penthouses, overlooking the majestoc Zayed National Museum. Each home is meticulously crafted to reflect elegance and refinement. 

Mandarin Oriental Residences amenities provide unparalleled convenience and leisure. Begin your day with your favorite treatment at the signature spa, indulge in lunch at the famed Mandarin Oriental Cake Shop, and end with a chef-prepared à la carte dinner on your private terrace—all effortlessly coordinated by a dedicated team of full-time Mandarin Oriental-trained residential staff.

Set in the prestigious Mandarin Oriental Residences location, residents are surrounded by iconic landmarks and pristine beaches. The master plan seamlessly blends cultural richness, natural beauty, and luxurious living.

characteristics_module.title: Where Elegance Meets Exclusivity: Redefining Luxury Living at Saadiyat Island
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Mandarin Oriental Residences at Saadiyat Island is in Abu Dhabi's prestigious cultural district.  
  • Luxury Real Estate: Offers 1 to 5-bedroom apartments and penthouses with world-class design and elegant interiors.  
  • Iconic Views: Enjoy breathtaking vistas of Zayed National Museum.  
  • World-Class Amenities: Includes indoor/outdoor pools, spas, fitness studios, kids’ clubs, cinemas, and concierge services.  
  • Cultural Immersion: Surrounded by renowned attractions like Louvre Abu Dhabi and the planned museum, Guggenheim Abu Dhabi.  
  • Refined Master Plan: Seamlessly blending nature, culture, and luxury into one sophisticated living experience.

location_tile.title: Experience Exceptional Living in the Heart of Saadiyat Cultural District
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Nestled in the prestigious Saadiyat Cultural District on Saadiyat Island, the Mandarin Oriental Residences redefine luxury living in Abu Dhabi. Surrounded by iconic landmarks such as the Louvre Abu Dhabi and the forthcoming Guggenheim Museum, this exclusive community offers unparalleled cultural immersion and sophistication. Every detail of the community reflects elegance and refinement, making it a haven for those seeking a truly exceptional lifestyle in the heart of Abu Dhabi’s cultural epicenter.

  • 05 Minutes to Louvre Abu Dhabi
  • 08 Minutes to Zayed National Museum
  • 15 Minutes to Yas Island
  • 20 Minutes to Corniche Road, Abu Dhabi
  • 20 Minutes to Abu Dhabi International Airport
